<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fix silently wrong MoE routing on ROCm when `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` is used with softmax-routed models whose fused shared experts have no gate, such as DeepSeek-V2-Lite (any model built on `DeepseekV2MoE` with softmax routing and one expert group). `AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter` (added in #39280 for Qwen3-Next) treated the last router-logit columns as a shared-expert gate for every such model.

## Claims

- Fixes wrong outputs with AITER shared-expert fusion on gate-less models, matching fusion off:
  - DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat (on `main`) GSM8K (strict) goes from 0.095 to 0.661 (fusion off 0.656).
  - Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B, with a local model implementation that builds its MoE layers with `main`'s `DeepseekV2MoE` (see Validation; not the `MistralMoE` of #64534): GSM8K (strict) goes from 0.718 to 0.959 at 5-shot (fusion off 0.957) and from 0.770 to 0.965 at 20-shot (fusion off 0.962), mean of 3 runs each.
- Qwen3-Next (gated shared expert) routing is unchanged: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct with fusion on scores the same before and after this PR (GSM8K flexible-extract 0.952 vs 0.953, fusion off 0.953, 3 runs each), and the gated unit test passes with the same assertions on `main`.
- With the fix, shared-expert fusion becomes usable for such models. On that Mistral Large 4 implementation, median TPOT is 21% lower than fusion off at concurrency 1, 7.5% lower at 8 and 5% lower at 32 (MI325X, TP8). No throughput regression on DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat.

## Validation

All runs on MI325X (gfx942), AITER 0.1.26, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, on a local ROCm build (vLLM 0.32.1rc1.dev361, 83c078d955). "Before" and "after" differ only in the three changed Python files, taken from before and after this change.

Mistral Large 4 is not in `main` yet, so we used a local Mistral Large 4 implementation that is not in `main` or in another PR. It builds every MoE layer (softmax top-4 over 128 routed experts plus one shared expert, no shared-expert gate, no score bias) with `main`'s `DeepseekV2MoE`, the class DeepSeek-V2-Lite uses, which passes `n_shared_experts` and `fuse_shared_experts` to `FusedMoEFactory`. With the flag set, it fuses the shared expert and takes this router. Mistral's working branch #64534 (at `bd4fa26`) instead passes the shared expert to `MistralMoE` as a separate MLP, so `num_fused_shared_experts` is 0, the factory picks `FusedTopKRouter`, and the flag has no effect: as published, #64534 neither hits this bug nor gets the TPOT gain from this PR alone. Fusing its shared expert would be a separate change, and it would need this fix.

**GSM8K, 5-shot (strict-match / flexible-extract)**

| Model | Fusion off | Fusion on, before | Fusion on, this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B (FP8), TP8, 1319 questions, run 1 | 0.960 / 0.970 | 0.717 / 0.889 | 0.958 / 0.967 |
| run 2 | 0.958 / 0.967 | 0.723 / 0.910 | 0.960 / 0.971 |
| run 3 | 0.953 / 0.967 | 0.715 / 0.897 | 0.959 / 0.970 |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, TP1, limit 1000 (CI ref 0.671 / 0.664) | 0.656 / 0.663 | 0.095 / 0.116 | 0.661 / 0.667 |

For Mistral Large 4, each run is paired against the fusion-off run with the same index (questions answered correctly only in that arm vs only with fusion off, exact McNemar test):

| Strict-match | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before vs fusion off | 5 vs 325, p < 0.001 | 12 vs 321, p < 0.001 | 11 vs 325, p < 0.001 |
| This PR vs fusion off | 15 vs 17, p = 0.86 | 14 vs 11, p = 0.69 | 21 vs 13, p = 0.23 |

Flexible-extract gives the same picture: before 9 vs 115, 10 vs 85, 10 vs 103 (all p < 0.001); this PR 9 vs 12, 11 vs 5, 10 vs 7 (p = 0.66, 0.21, 0.63).

**GSM8K, 20-shot, Mistral Large 4** (same server and command with `--num_fewshot 20`), strict-match / flexible-extract per run:

| | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fusion off | 0.967 / 0.970 | 0.959 / 0.969 | 0.961 / 0.967 |
| Fusion on, before | 0.772 / 0.898 | 0.774 / 0.897 | 0.764 / 0.896 |
| Fusion on, this PR | 0.964 / 0.968 | 0.967 / 0.972 | 0.964 / 0.972 |

Paired against fusion off (strict-match): before 4 vs 262, 15 vs 259, 5 vs 264 (all p < 0.001); this PR 9 vs 13, 18 vs 7, 16 vs 11 (p = 0.52, 0.04, 0.44). Run 2 leans towards this PR (p = 0.04, not corrected for the six comparisons); with flexible-extract the three runs are 8 vs 11, 10 vs 6, 14 vs 8 (p = 0.65, 0.45, 0.29).

**Gated shared expert: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct** (BF16, HF revision 9c7f2fbe84465e40164a94cc16cd30b6999b0cc7), TP2, GSM8K 5-shot, 1319 questions, strict-match / flexible-extract per run. Qwen3-Next ends its answers in a Markdown form such as "Final Answer: **160 minutes**", which strict-match mostly misses, so flexible-extract is the meaningful score here.

| | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fusion off | 0.652 / 0.951 | 0.659 / 0.954 | 0.663 / 0.954 |
| Fusion on, before | 0.644 / 0.954 | 0.650 / 0.949 | 0.654 / 0.955 |
| Fusion on, this PR | 0.654 / 0.950 | 0.658 / 0.954 | 0.650 / 0.955 |

Paired against fusion off (flexible-extract): before 10 vs 6, 7 vs 13, 10 vs 9 (p = 0.45, 0.26, 1.00); this PR 8 vs 9, 6 vs 6, 10 vs 8 (p = 1.00, 1.00, 0.81). Fusion is active in both fusion-on servers: their compiled graph has no `moe_forward_shared` op (fusion off: one per MoE layer, 48 layers), and both load the same compiled graph, so they differ only in the router code inside the MoE op.

The FP8 `mistralai/Mistral-Large-3-675B-Instruct-2512` checkpoint (TP8) is not affected: with the flag set, every layer logs `shared-expert FSE quantization compatibility is not implemented for CompressedTensorsConfig` and runs unfused, so `main` and this PR take the same path.

**Tests.** Two existing files are extended; no new test file.

- `tests/kernels/moe/test_rocm_aiter_topk.py::test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_without_shared_expert_gate`, next to the gated `test_rocm_aiter_topk_gating_shared_expert_suffix`. It builds the router with `create_fused_moe_router` with fusion enabled through the environment, and routes through `select_experts` with the real pre-filled AITER buffer. The last routed experts get the top logits for the first token and must be selected. The selection is checked against the softmax top-k cutoff over all routed experts, the routed weights against the scores of the selected experts (BF16 logits can tie at the boundary), and the shared slots keep their ids and `shared_expert_weight`. It doesn't pass the new argument, so it runs on `main` and fails on the routing itself. Cases: Mistral Large 4 (128 experts, top-4, 1 shared, renormalized), and DeepSeek-V2-Lite-like (64 experts, top-6, 2 shared, not renormalized as with `norm_topk_prob=False`, weight 0.5 to cover the `fill_` path), each with BF16 and FP32 logits.
- `test_rocm_aiter_topk.py::test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_with_shared_expert_gate` covers the gated path (Qwen3-Next: 512 experts, top-10, 1 shared) with `has_shared_expert_gate=True`. The routed top-k must match the softmax over the routed columns, and the shared slot must equal the sigmoid of the last logit column, with BF16 and FP32 logits. With AITER 0.1.26 this is the fused-sigmoid kernel path.
- `tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py::test_models_fse_init` now also asserts that every fused layer using this router has `has_shared_expert_gate` set for its model: `True` for Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5 and Qwen4-exp, `False` for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3.2.

Run from this branch's Python sources on top of the compiled extensions of the local build above, with `main` = the three changed source files from `main`:

```
$ pytest tests/kernels/moe/test_rocm_aiter_topk.py tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py
main:     16 failed, 199 passed, 3 skipped
          test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_with_shared_expert_gate (2 cases):
            TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'has_shared_expert_gate' (see below)
          test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_without_shared_expert_gate (4 cases):
            assert {127} <= {11, 26, 112, 120}        (last routed expert never selected)
            assert {62, 63} <= {11, 18, 26, 30, 39, 42}
          test_models_fse_init (10 fused cases above):
            AttributeError: 'AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter' object has no attribute 'has_shared_expert_gate'
this PR:  215 passed, 3 skipped
this PR without the layer.py line:
          6 failed (test_models_fse_init, fused Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 / Qwen4-exp cases)
```

The gated test passes with the same assertions on `main` when the `has_shared_expert_gate=True` argument is removed (`main` always takes the gated path), so the gated routing is unchanged.

The flag can't get out of sync with the logits: `MoERunner` appends the shared-expert gate logits only when it receives both `gate` and `shared_expert_gate`, which only `FusedMoEFactory` passes. The factory derives `has_shared_expert_gate` from `shared_expert_gate` and asserts that a `shared_expert_gate` comes with a `gate`; the runner uses `shared_expert_gate` for nothing else, so without `gate` it would be silently dropped. Qwen3-Next and AliceAI, the only callers passing `shared_expert_gate`, both pass `gate`. The only other `create_fused_moe_router` caller (Step5 on NVIDIA) doesn't use fused shared experts.

Behavioral reproducer on `main` (router built by `create_fused_moe_router` exactly as `FusedMoEFactory` does for a gate-less model; 128 experts, top-4, 1 shared, as in Mistral Large 4; 4096 tokens):

```
                         main            this PR
top-4 matches reference  96.6% of rows   100%
expert 127 selected      0 (ref 139)     139 (ref 139)
shared-expert weight     0.0012..0.9984  1.0 (constant)
```

**Related tests** on the local build, before and after: `tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py`, `tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py`, `test_rocm_aiter_topk.py`, `test_fused_topk.py`, `test_rocm_aiter_num_expert_group.py`, `tests/quantization/test_online_shared_expert_fusion.py`: 1538 passed on both. 16 online-quantization FSE tests fail identically before and after on this local build; they don't touch the router.

**Performance**, `vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 8×C --max-concurrency C`, seeds 0, 1 and 2, after a warm-up. Mistral Large 4 with the server above, fusion on (this PR) vs fusion off, mean over the 3 seeds (the seed ranges of the two arms don't overlap in any cell; no failed requests):

| Concurrency | TPOT p50 (ms) | ITL p50 (ms) | Output tok/s | TTFT p50 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 13.50 → 10.69 | 13.46 → 10.66 | 73.4 → 92.6 | 139 → 116 |
| 8 | 17.73 → 16.40 | 17.75 → 16.43 | 437 → 476 | 623 → 464 |
| 32 | 28.00 → 26.67 | 27.40 → 26.29 | 1092 → 1154 | 1193 → 949 |

Both arms use the same AITER GEMM and fused-MoE tuning tables for this model; with the default tables the absolute numbers will differ. Before this PR, fusion on is not a usable baseline on this model because its outputs are wrong.

DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat TP1, random 1024 in / 256 out, 3 runs each: output throughput with fusion on (this PR) vs fusion off is 268 vs 262 tok/s at concurrency 1, 2175 vs 2170 at 16, 5371 vs 5357 at 64. No regression; no speedup is claimed there.

CI: the routing test runs in the AMD "MoE Kernels" step (`pytest kernels/moe`), and `test_models_fse_init` in the AMD "Model Executor" step (`pytest model_executor`).

## Details

**Root cause.** `create_fused_moe_router` selects `AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter` when `num_fused_shared_experts > 0`, scoring is softmax, there is no `e_score_correction_bias` or custom routing function, grouping is degenerate, and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, AITER MoE and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` are set. The router assumes every such model has a sigmoid shared-expert gate whose logits are appended as the last `num_fused_shared_experts` columns of `router_logits` (true for Qwen3-Next, where `MoERunner` concatenates `gate` and `shared_expert_gate`). For gate-less models, `router_logits` only has routed experts, so the last routed experts are treated as gate logits: they can never be selected, and their sigmoid becomes the shared-expert weight. Shapes stay valid, so nothing crashes.

Affected:
- Mistral Large 4 (128 experts, top-4, 1 shared) when its MoE layers fuse the shared expert, as in the local implementation measured above. Not #64534 as published, which keeps the shared expert unfused.
- DeepSeek-V2-Lite / -Lite-Chat and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct (64 experts, top-6, 2 shared, 1 group), measured above.
- The BF16 Mistral-Large-3 checkpoint has the same gate-less softmax routing (128 experts, 1 shared) and takes the same path by code inspection; not measured here.

Not affected: gated shared experts (Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5), sigmoid routing with a score bias (DeepSeek-V3/R1, Kimi-K2, GLM), and real expert grouping (DeepSeek-V2, V2.5).

**Fix.** `FusedMoEFactory` passes `has_shared_expert_gate=shared_expert_gate is not None` through `create_fused_moe_router` (default `False`). Without a gate, the router runs the softmax top-k over all routed logits directly into the routed columns of `aiter_topK_meta_data`, picked by `dispatch_topk_softmax_func` like the fusion-off `FusedTopKRouter` (`topk_gating` on gfx942/gfx950 up to 4096 tokens, legacy `topk_softmax` otherwise). Both kernels honor the row stride, and `init_aiter_topK_meta_data` pre-fills the shared slots (ids after the routed experts, weight 1.0; per-rank sentinel ids with EP). It stays one kernel launch, plus one `fill_` only when `shared_expert_weight != 1.0`. The gated path is untouched.

**Duplicate check.** No open or merged PR or issue mentions `has_shared_expert_gate` or fixes this; the related hits (#42964, #44651, #53248, #61457) address imports and quantization compatibility, not the routing. #60217 (MoE balanced routing) only touches `base_router.py`.

Thanks @xaguilar-amd for this! This seems like a valid fix for DeepSeek-V2-Lite on main.

Did you do Mistral related tests with local code not yet in main or in other PRs?

This is the only test that checks the routing itself; test_models_fse_init only checks the flag. Its kernels/moe steps (MI300 and MI355 DPX MoE Kernels Shard) are optional: true in .buildkite/test-amd.yaml:1220 and :4583, so they don't run on a PR by default. Could you unblock one once CI runs and link the build, or note in the description that the step is optional?

<!-- markdownlint-disable -->

## Overview

Fix silently wrong MoE routing on ROCm when `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` is used with softmax-routed models whose fused shared experts have no gate, such as DeepSeek-V2-Lite (any model built on `DeepseekV2MoE` with softmax routing and one expert group). `AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter` (added in #39280 for Qwen3-Next) treated the last router-logit columns as a shared-expert gate for every such model.

## Claims

- Fixes wrong outputs with AITER shared-expert fusion on gate-less models, matching fusion off:
  - DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat (on `main`) GSM8K (strict) goes from 0.095 to 0.661 (fusion off 0.656).
  - Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B, with a local model implementation that builds its MoE layers with `main`'s `DeepseekV2MoE` (see Validation; not the `MistralMoE` of #64534): GSM8K (strict) goes from 0.718 to 0.959 at 5-shot (fusion off 0.957) and from 0.770 to 0.965 at 20-shot (fusion off 0.962), mean of 3 runs each.
- Qwen3-Next (gated shared expert) routing is unchanged: Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct with fusion on scores the same before and after this PR (GSM8K flexible-extract 0.952 vs 0.953, fusion off 0.953, 3 runs each), and the gated unit test passes with the same assertions on `main`.
- With the fix, shared-expert fusion becomes usable for such models. On that Mistral Large 4 implementation, median TPOT is 21% lower than fusion off at concurrency 1, 7.5% lower at 8 and 5% lower at 32 (MI325X, TP8). No throughput regression on DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat.

## Validation

All runs on MI325X (gfx942), AITER 0.1.26, `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, on a local ROCm build (vLLM 0.32.1rc1.dev361, 83c078d955). "Before" and "after" differ only in the three changed Python files, taken from before and after this change.

Mistral Large 4 is not in `main` yet, so we used a local Mistral Large 4 implementation that is not in `main` or in another PR. It builds every MoE layer (softmax top-4 over 128 routed experts plus one shared expert, no shared-expert gate, no score bias) with `main`'s `DeepseekV2MoE`, the class DeepSeek-V2-Lite uses, which passes `n_shared_experts` and `fuse_shared_experts` to `FusedMoEFactory`. With the flag set, it fuses the shared expert and takes this router. Mistral's working branch #64534 (at `bd4fa26`) instead passes the shared expert to `MistralMoE` as a separate MLP, so `num_fused_shared_experts` is 0, the factory picks `FusedTopKRouter`, and the flag has no effect: as published, #64534 neither hits this bug nor gets the TPOT gain from this PR alone. Fusing its shared expert would be a separate change, and it would need this fix.

**GSM8K, 5-shot (strict-match / flexible-extract)**

| Model | Fusion off | Fusion on, before | Fusion on, this PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B (FP8), TP8, 1319 questions, run 1 | 0.960 / 0.970 | 0.717 / 0.889 | 0.958 / 0.967 |
| run 2 | 0.958 / 0.967 | 0.723 / 0.910 | 0.960 / 0.971 |
| run 3 | 0.953 / 0.967 | 0.715 / 0.897 | 0.959 / 0.970 |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat, TP1, limit 1000 (CI ref 0.671 / 0.664) | 0.656 / 0.663 | 0.095 / 0.116 | 0.661 / 0.667 |

| Strict-match | Run 1 | Run 2 | Run 3 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Before vs fusion off | 5 vs 325, p < 0.001 | 12 vs 321, p < 0.001 | 11 vs 325, p < 0.001 |
| This PR vs fusion off | 15 vs 17, p = 0.86 | 14 vs 11, p = 0.69 | 21 vs 13, p = 0.23 |

Flexible-extract gives the same picture: before 9 vs 115, 10 vs 85, 10 vs 103 (all p < 0.001); this PR 9 vs 12, 11 vs 5, 10 vs 7 (p = 0.66, 0.21, 0.63).

**GSM8K, 20-shot, Mistral Large 4** (same server and command with `--num_fewshot 20`), strict-match / flexible-extract per run:

Fusion is active in both fusion-on servers: their compiled graph has no `moe_forward_shared` op (fusion off: one per MoE layer, 48 layers), and both load the same compiled graph, so they differ only in the router code inside the MoE op.

```bash
VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS={0,1} \

  --max-model-len 16384 --no-enable-prefix-caching

  --model_args '{"model":"Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct","base_url":"http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/chat/completions","tokenizer_backend":"None","num_concurrent":32,"max_gen_toks":2048,"max_retries":8,"timeout":900}' \

# .buildkite/lm-eval-harness/run-lm-eval-gsm-vllm-baseline.sh, with -t 1

  --model_args "pretrained=deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat,tensor_parallel_size=1,add_bos_token=true,trust_remote_code=true,max_model_len=4096" \

```

The FP8 `mistralai/Mistral-Large-3-675B-Instruct-2512` checkpoint (TP8) is not affected: with the flag set, every layer logs `shared-expert FSE quantization compatibility is not implemented for CompressedTensorsConfig` and runs unfused, so `main` and this PR take the same path.

**Tests.** Two existing files are extended; no new test file.

- `tests/kernels/moe/test_rocm_aiter_topk.py::test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_without_shared_expert_gate`, next to the gated `test_rocm_aiter_topk_gating_shared_expert_suffix`. It builds the router with `create_fused_moe_router` with fusion enabled through the environment, and routes through `select_experts` with the real pre-filled AITER buffer. The last routed experts get the top logits for the first token and must be selected. The selection is checked against the softmax top-k cutoff over all routed experts, the routed weights against the scores of the selected experts (BF16 logits can tie at the boundary), and the shared slots keep their ids and `shared_expert_weight`. It doesn't pass the new argument, so it runs on `main` and fails on the routing itself. Cases: Mistral Large 4 (128 experts, top-4, 1 shared, renormalized), and DeepSeek-V2-Lite-like (64 experts, top-6, 2 shared, not renormalized as with `norm_topk_prob=False`, weight 0.5 to cover the `fill_` path), each with BF16 and FP32 logits.
- `test_rocm_aiter_topk.py::test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_with_shared_expert_gate` covers the gated path (Qwen3-Next: 512 experts, top-10, 1 shared) with `has_shared_expert_gate=True`. The routed top-k must match the softmax over the routed columns, and the shared slot must equal the sigmoid of the last logit column, with BF16 and FP32 logits. With AITER 0.1.26 this is the fused-sigmoid kernel path.
- `tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py::test_models_fse_init` now also asserts that every fused layer using this router has `has_shared_expert_gate` set for its model: `True` for Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5 and Qwen4-exp, `False` for DeepSeek-V2 and DeepSeek-V3.2.

Run from this branch's Python sources on top of the compiled extensions of the local build above, with `main` = the three changed source files from `main`:

```
$ pytest tests/kernels/moe/test_rocm_aiter_topk.py tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py
main:     16 failed, 199 passed, 3 skipped
          test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_with_shared_expert_gate (2 cases):
            TypeError: unexpected keyword argument 'has_shared_expert_gate' (see below)
          test_rocm_aiter_shared_routed_router_without_shared_expert_gate (4 cases):
            assert {127} <= {11, 26, 112, 120}        (last routed expert never selected)
            assert {62, 63} <= {11, 18, 26, 30, 39, 42}
          test_models_fse_init (10 fused cases above):
            AttributeError: 'AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter' object has no attribute 'has_shared_expert_gate'
this PR:  215 passed, 3 skipped
this PR without the layer.py line:
          6 failed (test_models_fse_init, fused Qwen3-Next / Qwen3.5 / Qwen4-exp cases)
```

The gated test passes with the same assertions on `main` when the `has_shared_expert_gate=True` argument is removed (`main` always takes the gated path), so the gated routing is unchanged.

The flag can't get out of sync with the logits: `MoERunner` appends the shared-expert gate logits only when it receives both `gate` and `shared_expert_gate`, which only `FusedMoEFactory` passes. The factory derives `has_shared_expert_gate` from `shared_expert_gate` and asserts that a `shared_expert_gate` comes with a `gate`; the runner uses `shared_expert_gate` for nothing else, so without `gate` it would be silently dropped. Qwen3-Next and AliceAI, the only callers passing `shared_expert_gate`, both pass `gate`. The only other `create_fused_moe_router` caller (Step5 on NVIDIA) doesn't use fused shared experts.

Behavioral reproducer on `main` (router built by `create_fused_moe_router` exactly as `FusedMoEFactory` does for a gate-less model; 128 experts, top-4, 1 shared, as in Mistral Large 4; 4096 tokens):

```
                         main            this PR
top-4 matches reference  96.6% of rows   100%
expert 127 selected      0 (ref 139)     139 (ref 139)
shared-expert weight     0.0012..0.9984  1.0 (constant)
```

**Related tests** on the local build, before and after: `tests/model_executor/layers/test_fused_shared_expert.py`, `tests/kernels/moe/test_routing.py`, `test_rocm_aiter_topk.py`, `test_fused_topk.py`, `test_rocm_aiter_num_expert_group.py`, `tests/quantization/test_online_shared_expert_fusion.py`: 1538 passed on both. 16 online-quantization FSE tests fail identically before and after on this local build; they don't touch the router.

**Performance**, `vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --ignore-eos --num-prompts 8×C --max-concurrency C`, seeds 0, 1 and 2, after a warm-up. Mistral Large 4 with the server above, fusion on (this PR) vs fusion off, mean over the 3 seeds (the seed ranges of the two arms don't overlap in any cell; no failed requests):

| Concurrency | TPOT p50 (ms) | ITL p50 (ms) | Output tok/s | TTFT p50 (ms) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 13.50 → 10.69 | 13.46 → 10.66 | 73.4 → 92.6 | 139 → 116 |
| 8 | 17.73 → 16.40 | 17.75 → 16.43 | 437 → 476 | 623 → 464 |
| 32 | 28.00 → 26.67 | 27.40 → 26.29 | 1092 → 1154 | 1193 → 949 |

Both arms use the same AITER GEMM and fused-MoE tuning tables for this model; with the default tables the absolute numbers will differ. Before this PR, fusion on is not a usable baseline on this model because its outputs are wrong.

DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat TP1, random 1024 in / 256 out, 3 runs each: output throughput with fusion on (this PR) vs fusion off is 268 vs 262 tok/s at concurrency 1, 2175 vs 2170 at 16, 5371 vs 5357 at 64. No regression; no speedup is claimed there.

CI: the routing test runs in the AMD "MoE Kernels" step (`pytest kernels/moe`), and `test_models_fse_init` in the AMD "Model Executor" step (`pytest model_executor`).

## Details

**Root cause.** `create_fused_moe_router` selects `AiterSharedRoutedFusedMoERouter` when `num_fused_shared_experts > 0`, scoring is softmax, there is no `e_score_correction_bias` or custom routing function, grouping is degenerate, and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1`, AITER MoE and `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_FUSION_SHARED_EXPERTS=1` are set. The router assumes every such model has a sigmoid shared-expert gate whose logits are appended as the last `num_fused_shared_experts` columns of `router_logits` (true for Qwen3-Next, where `MoERunner` concatenates `gate` and `shared_expert_gate`). For gate-less models, `router_logits` only has routed experts, so the last routed experts are treated as gate logits: they can never be selected, and their sigmoid becomes the shared-expert weight. Shapes stay valid, so nothing crashes.

Affected:
- Mistral Large 4 (128 experts, top-4, 1 shared) when its MoE layers fuse the shared expert, as in the local implementation measured above. Not #64534 as published, which keeps the shared expert unfused.
- DeepSeek-V2-Lite / -Lite-Chat and DeepSeek-Coder-V2-Lite-Instruct (64 experts, top-6, 2 shared, 1 group), measured above.
- The BF16 Mistral-Large-3 checkpoint has the same gate-less softmax routing (128 experts, 1 shared) and takes the same path by code inspection; not measured here.

Not affected: gated shared experts (Qwen3-Next, Qwen3.5), sigmoid routing with a score bias (DeepSeek-V3/R1, Kimi-K2, GLM), and real expert grouping (DeepSeek-V2, V2.5).

**Fix.** `FusedMoEFactory` passes `has_shared_expert_gate=shared_expert_gate is not None` through `create_fused_moe_router` (default `False`). Without a gate, the router runs the softmax top-k over all routed logits directly into the routed columns of `aiter_topK_meta_data`, picked by `dispatch_topk_softmax_func` like the fusion-off `FusedTopKRouter` (`topk_gating` on gfx942/gfx950 up to 4096 tokens, legacy `topk_softmax` otherwise). Both kernels honor the row stride, and `init_aiter_topK_meta_data` pre-fills the shared slots (ids after the routed experts, weight 1.0; per-rank sentinel ids with EP). It stays one kernel launch, plus one `fill_` only when `shared_expert_weight != 1.0`. The gated path is untouched.

**Duplicate check.** No open or merged PR or issue mentions `has_shared_expert_gate` or fixes this; the related hits (#42964, #44651, #53248, #61457) address imports and quantization compatibility, not the routing. #60217 (MoE balanced routing) only touches `base_router.py`.
